name: Joint Military-Police Street Patrols
detail: Authorized by the April 2024 referendum (72% approval), armed forces patrol jointly with National Police in high-violence urban areas and highways under successive states of emergency.

name: Prison System Intervention Units
detail: Combined SNAI (prison authority) and military units deployed to retake and hold control of high-risk prisons, including Litoral Penitentiary, Machala, and Esmeraldas facilities, with limited success amid continued riots through 2025.

name: Grupo de Operaciones Especiales (GOE) and Comandos
detail: Elite special operations units responsible for high-value target captures, including the June 2025 recapture of 'Fito' in a Manta bunker and the extradition-linked capture of alias 'Gato Negro' in Colombia.

name: US Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) Training & Equipment Program
detail: Provides training, intelligence-sharing, and equipment to Ecuadorian security forces under the 2024 SOFA framework, expanded significantly following the September 2025 FTO designations.

name: Temporary US Air Force Presence at Eloy Alfaro Air Base, Manta
detail: US Air Force personnel deployed to Manta in 2025 for joint intelligence and interdiction training — the first acknowledged US military return to the former Manta Forward Operating Location since it closed in 2009.

name: B-52 Bilateral Defense Exercise
detail: A US Air Force B-52 strategic bomber entered Ecuadorian airspace for the first time in early 2026 as part of a bilateral defense cooperation exercise, signaling the scale of renewed US military engagement.

name: El Encuentro Maximum-Security Prison, Santa Elena
detail: New mega-prison opened November 11, 2025, part of a program announced in January 2024 to build capacity for 12,000 inmates nationwide and isolate high-value gang leadership from the general prison population.

name: La Roca Maximum-Security Prison, Guayaquil
detail: Existing maximum-security facility used to hold top gang leadership, including 'Fito' after his June 2025 recapture, prior to transfers to newer facilities like El Encuentro.

name: DHS/ICE Migration & Counter-Narcotics Cooperation Framework
detail: Formalized during Secretary Kristi Noem's August 2025 visit to Quito, coordinating US Department of Homeland Security resources with Ecuadorian authorities on migration control and port-level trafficking interdiction.

name: $180 Million Security Equipment Investment
detail: Defense Minister Gian Carlo Loffredo-announced procurement program to modernize armed forces and police equipment, funded partly through US cooperation and domestic budget allocation amid the ongoing conflict.
